problem:
Independently verify only the following exact new geometric partial result for P03.1: For every usc obstacle, the full local-Fubini--Study/semipositive-real-PL regularized envelope is classically psh on products of a perfected-bijective-normalization strict curve with a smooth geometrically connected projective factor, and on analytic projective bundles over such curves. Exact global competitor descent and ordinary projection/regularization compatibility are proved. Concrete normal domains and nonnormal geometrically unibranch cusp products are realized. Explicit continuous-obstacle failures are proved for split branches, codimension-two seminormal point gluings including a single irreducible bidisc with two points pinched, and the irreducible nonsplit quadratic-node surface over Q_3.

The entire final proof, every actual native canonical note and published primary-source passages are supplied directly. This is a correctness/completeness review of the stated geometric theorems and counterexamples. It is not a review of the earlier conditional abstract or toric drafts, and it does not claim closure of the original sharp-classification target.
completionCriteria: Independently reconstruct the curve-family lemma and exact full semipositive-real-PL family descent for arbitrary smooth geometrically connected projective factors and analytic projective bundles, including factors lacking a rational point. Check perfected scalar/reduction/normalization homeomorphisms, the directed finite-max family anchored at a continuous member, literal local boundedness, absolute boundary extension and all scalar/curve quantifiers. Check degree-zero proper torsion comparison for fibre connectedness; completed residue-field fibres; maximum principles only in their relative interior; finite-extension real-PL and semipositivity descent with divisible coefficients; actual smooth openness, proper closedness, sheaf gluing, fibre INFIMUM for usc obstacles and empty families; normal and cusp-product geometry. Reconstruct ALL split-node, seminormal codimension-two pinching and irreducible nonsplit-node-surface counterexamples, including analytic germ seminormality, strict charts, global obstacle continuity, rational LFS membership, binomial coefficient bounds, the exact minorant estimates on every point, and the scalar curve failure. No general higher-dimensional necessity or sharp classification is claimed. Check the original definitions, source versions and EVERY indispensable new source application. Published foundations may be cited with their exact hypotheses, but new applications need complete proofs. Do not use supplied book assertions, prior reviews, source hashes, finite diagnostics or compilation as proof certificates. PASS only if the entire exact scope is correct and completely justified; FAIL for a substantive false statement or proof defect; INCONCLUSIVE for an unresolved indispensable premise. Use Xean native Codex gpt-6.1-sol/xhigh. Do not read private transcripts, SQL, authentication, other generated draft workspaces or any blocked P15/P03.3 review inputs. Do not invoke other models, workers or subagents, change runtime/account/sandbox, install software or send external messages. Original catalogue closure is explicitly separate.
